name: Bugsink
summary: Bugsink is a small error tracker that accepts Sentry SDKs. Managed plans start at 16 euros a month for 75,000 events with unlimited users and EU hosting, and the self-hosted version is free. Prices are listed in euros only.

facts.text: Bugsink normalizes variable parts of a message, such as IP addresses, numbers and durations, before grouping, and custom fingerprints are supported.
By default it alerts on new issues, regressions and issues that come out of a mute, not on every event added to an open issue.
Releases are inferred from events that carry a release identifier, since setting them up in the interface or command line is not yet available.
Managed data is stored and processed in the EU, and the data processing agreement sets a 60-day retention for raw event data.
Existing Sentry SDKs work by changing the DSN.
